                    URBAN HELPERS APP - BUILD & TEST GUIDE

STATUS: ✅ READY TO USE

LOCATION: c:\Users\Vichu\OneDrive\Desktop\UrbanHelpersApp

================================================================================
📱 TEST YOUR APP RIGHT NOW (5 MINUTES)
================================================================================

STEP 1: Download Expo Go
  → Google Play Store
  → Search "Expo Go"
  → Install

STEP 2: Open Expo Go App on Phone

STEP 3: Tap QR Code Icon

STEP 4: Point Camera at Terminal Screen
  (Look for QR code in terminal - black & white square)

STEP 5: App Loads!
  → Urban Helpers app appears on your phone
  → All 44 screens ready to test
  → You can navigate and interact

RESULT: ✅ App running on your phone in ~5 minutes!

================================================================================
📦 BUILD STANDALONE APK (15 MINUTES)
================================================================================

If you want permanent APK (works without Expo Go):

STEP 1: Stop Dev Server
  → Press Ctrl+C in terminal

STEP 2: Create Free Expo Account
  eas login
  (Enter email and password)

STEP 3: Build APK in Cloud
  eas build --platform android --profile preview
  (Takes 10-15 minutes, you'll get email with download link)

STEP 4: Download APK
  (Check email for link)

STEP 5: Deploy to Phone
  adb install -r C:\path\to\app.apk

RESULT: ✅ Permanent APK on your phone!

================================================================================
⚡ QUICK REFERENCE
================================================================================

DEV SERVER KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS:
  s  → Switch to Expo Go
  a  → Open in Android Emulator
  w  → Open in Web Browser (see app in browser!)
  r  → Reload app
  j  → Debugger
  m  → Menu
  ?  → All commands

IMPORTANT COMMANDS:
  npm start                                 → Start dev server
  eas login                                → Login to Expo
  eas build --platform android             → Build APK
  adb install -r app.apk                  → Deploy APK

================================================================================
❓ COMMON QUESTIONS
================================================================================

Q: Where's the QR code?
A: In the terminal where you see the black & white square

Q: How do I scan it?
A: Expo Go app → Tap QR code icon → Point camera

Q: Can't scan?
A: Press 's' in terminal, then type the link in Expo Go

Q: Want to stop dev server?
A: Press Ctrl+C in terminal

Q: Want to test in browser?
A: Press 'w' in terminal

Q: Ready to build APK?
A: eas login → eas build --platform android --profile preview

Q: Building takes too long?
A: Normal (queue on busy days), you'll get email when done

Q: ADB not found?
A: It's included with Android SDK, should work from android folder
